ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity white central pixels to 30% low-intensity black perimeter and streak pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the central regions of both lobes; low-intensity black pixels are concentrated at the peduncle junction, leading edges, and as radiating linear streaks toward the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute pixel angle; depth spans approximately 1/6th of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with varying pixel-amplitude along the entire trailing boundary; most pronounced jaggedness occurs on the distal quarter of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a concave curve from the median notch to the tips; the overall fluke shape exhibits a standard bi-lobed convexity at the leading edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-contrast white irregular cluster on the distal tip of the left lobe; smaller isolated white pixel clusters present on the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct vertical and diagonal black linear disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across the ventral surface and minor irregular indentations along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark vertical band of pixels on the right lobe situated between the center and the tip, creating a high-contrast interruption of the white field.
